text: {"name": "count_pending_commands", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Walks a global command queue and counts valid pending commands in each entry's nested command chain, returning zero if no queue is present or an entry has the abort/processing flag set.", "subsystem": "ipc", "var_renames": {"v0": "cmd_queue_entry", "result": "pending_count", "v2": "cmd_chain_entry"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 0, "meaning": "next pointer to next command queue entry"}, {"offset": 106, "meaning": "processing/abort flag; nonzero stops the scan and yields zero"}, {"offset": 108, "meaning": "presence/valid flag for the entry's nested command chain"}, {"offset": 116, "meaning": "command status/validity byte; 0xFF excludes this entry from the count"}, {"offset": 240, "meaning": "pointer to head of this entry's nested command chain"}]}
